//: The GObject view layer. Same strict options as tsconfig.json but with strictNullChecks relaxed. PanelMenu.Button initializes its fields in _init() (not a constructor), and JSDoc has no definite-assignment (!) operator, so strict-null reports a false 'possibly undefined' on every _init-assigned widget. Class-field declarations can't fix it either — in GObject.registerClass classes the field initializers run after _init() and clobber it. All other strict checks (noImplicitAny, etc.) stay on here.
